connect_orchestrator: connect an OrchestratorInterface to the orchestrator server using robot_id and job_type
request_robot_job_work_unit: request a robot job work unit from the orchestrator and start working on it
complete_work_unit: complete the current work unit with an outcome, success score, and optional session notes
create_visual_overlays: create visual overlay renderers from the current work unit scene preset reference images
upload_text_log_artifact: upload a text log artifact to the orchestrator for the current robot job
